verdicts.reason: A: the crop puts the quote right on top of the child's face and fist, which is the busiest, brightest part of the photo, so the white text loses contrast. The thin frame is clipped at the top, and the attribution floats far off to the right, though it still reads quote first, then author. B has the same problem with the quote over the fist and face, and also places the attribution at the far left, so it is read before the quote. That attribution is also tiny and crammed against the left edge, and the original's short dash has turned into a long stray line on the right that connects to nothing.
